headline: Itaú Unibanco Reports Q3 ROE of 23.6% and Loan Growth
summary: Itaú Unibanco reported a third-quarter return on equity of 23.6% alongside credit portfolio growth. Its balance sheet remained solid with a core capital ratio rising 40 basis points to 12.7%.
why: Itaú Unibanco is one of the largest private-sector financial institutions in Latin America, serving millions of clients across Brazil and the region, making its earnings a key barometer for South American banking health.

impacts.name: Itaú Unibanco
impacts.why: Strong earnings and solid capital metrics typically drive positive investor sentiment for the bank's equity.

why_moved: Better-than-expected credit expansion and high return on equity relative to competitors highlighted robust operational performance despite a challenging macroeconomic backdrop.
